rows.claim_topic: Assessment accelerator vs Well-Architected pillars (operations, security, reliability, performance, cost, sustainability)
rows.evidence_summary: AWS Well-Architected Framework currently lists six pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, sustainability.
rows.action: Keep. Optionally use full pillar names ('performance efficiency', 'cost optimization'); describe accelerator as Quadra's own, not an AWS tool or AWS-certified review.

sources.title: The pillars of the framework - AWS Well-Architected Framework

rows.claim_topic: Agentic AI: approved tools, identity/permissions, human approvals for high-risk actions, logging/monitoring
rows.evidence_summary: AgentCore Policy evaluates agent-to-tool requests at Gateway against deterministic Cedar policies before tool access; Agentic AI Lens advises tool authorization plus human review for mutating operations.
rows.action: Keep wording. Phrase human approval as a design control Quadra configures, not an automatic AgentCore feature; avoid absolute 'secure' guarantees.

rows.claim_topic: AI-assisted discovery, dependency analysis, wave planning, VMware migration with 'lower risk and greater predictability'
rows.evidence_summary: AWS Transform offers agentic discovery, dependency analysis, wave planning and VMware/bare-metal rehost; AWS timeline claims are AWS marketing, not outcome guarantees for any partner engagement.
rows.action: Keep capability prose. Retain 'help reduce'/'support' framing; do not add timeline, cost-saving or performance guarantees; do not imply AWS Transform outcomes transfer to Quadra projects.

rows.claim_topic: Predictive ML (forecasting, anomaly, maintenance, risk) with lifecycle validation, monitoring, versioning, governance
rows.evidence_summary: SageMaker AI documents model governance tooling: Role Manager, Model Cards (intended use, risk rating, evaluation), Model Dashboard integrating Model Monitor for performance tracking.
rows.action: Keep. Add qualification that prediction quality depends on customer data and validation; no accuracy claims without customer evidence.

rows.claim_topic: Backup/DR aligned to business-defined RPO/RTO with regular recovery testing
